sources.title: Shopify Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

scenes.title: $119.1B sold on Shopify
scenes.sub: In just 3 months. So how does Shopify get paid?
scenes.sub_html: In just 3 months. So how does Shopify get paid?

lines.say: In three months, shoppers spent one hundred nineteen point one billion dollars at stores built on Shopify.
lines.show: In three months, shoppers spent $119.1 billion at stores built on Shopify.

lines.say: So how does Shopify get paid?
lines.show: So how does Shopify get paid?

lines.say: Shopify's revenue was three point seven four billion dollars. That's about three cents of every dollar sold.
lines.show: Shopify's revenue was $3.74 billion. That's about 3 cents of every dollar sold.

lines.say: Seventy eight percent came from merchant solutions, mostly payment processing fees.
lines.show: 78% came from merchant solutions, mostly payment processing fees.

lines.say: The rest came from subscriptions, like the plans, apps and themes stores pay for.
lines.show: The rest came from subscriptions, like the plans, apps and themes stores pay for.

scenes.label: more revenue than a year ago

lines.say: Revenue grew thirty two percent in a year.

scenes.label: recurring, every month
scenes.note: Monthly recurring revenue, up 19% in a year

lines.say: Its monthly subscription revenue hit two hundred thirty million dollars, up nineteen percent.
lines.show: Its monthly subscription revenue hit $230 million, up 19%.

scenes.label: operating income
scenes.note: July to Sept. 2026. A year earlier: $343M

lines.say: And operating income rose to five hundred sixty eight million dollars.
lines.show: And operating income rose to $568 million.

scenes.takeaway: Every sale on a Shopify store sends Shopify a small cut.
